title: Standby element extension
description: The manifest of an element extension: a folder (and a repository) with elements/<category>/<id>.json, boards/<id>.json and the assets/2d/*.svg and assets/3d/*.glb its elements are drawn from. A release publishes it as <id>-<version>.zip with this file at its root.

format.description: The extension format; this schema describes 1.

id.description: The extension's id, such as common or cma; a new extension's element ids start with it.

version.description: Its version, x.y.z; a release is tagged vx.y.z.

standby.description: The oldest Standby version it works with, x.y.z.

repository.description: Its GitHub repository, owner/name, where updates come from.

disciplines.description: The disciplines its elements are for.

stageDefaults.description: What a discipline's stages use where nothing else says: the board movers and targets made in the app take, and the target a bullet trap carries.

aliases.description: Older element ids and the element of this extension they now resolve to.

order.description: The order its elements are listed in within a palette category; others follow by id.

names.description: The name in each UI language.
